ann: Improve distributed multi-GPU scaling and reduce memory overhead for billion-scale vector indexing across heterogeneous hardware platforms.
cli: Improve performance and reduce overhead for large-scale CLI applications with thousands of commands or complex nested command hierarchies.
columnar: Improve cross-language serialization performance and reduce memory overhead when exchanging large datasets between heterogeneous data systems.
compiler: Improve GPU compilation performance and expand CUDA support for more complex numerical algorithms and data structures.
crypto: Improve performance and reduce binary size of OpenSSL bindings, particularly for mobile and edge computing environments where these constraints are critical.
cv: Improve cross-platform deployment efficiency and reduce model inference latency for real-time production applications.
db: Improve performance and reduce memory consumption when processing extremely large datasets that exceed available RAM through more efficient external sorting and spilling strategies.
diffusion: Better support for audio and 3D generation modalities beyond the current emphasis on image diffusion models.
encryption: Improve performance and reduce memory usage for encrypting/decrypting very large files efficiently.
graph: Improve distributed training efficiency and scalability for large-scale graph neural networks across multiple GPUs and nodes.
http: Improve performance and reduce latency for high-concurrency scenarios through built-in async/await support and connection pooling optimizations.
linter: Improve cross-language linting support and integration with non-Python codebases to expand beyond Python-only analysis.
llminfer: Improve cross-platform GPU acceleration support and reduce inference latency across diverse hardware backends and model architectures.
numerics: Improve GPU acceleration and performance optimization for computationally intensive operations like linear algebra, FFT, and statistical functions on large datasets.
peft: Improve inference speed and memory efficiency for deployed fine-tuned models across diverse hardware platforms and batch sizes.
rag: Improve distributed indexing and retrieval scalability to handle multi-billion document collections with lower latency and memory overhead.
rl: Improve sample efficiency and reduce training time required for convergence on complex, high-dimensional control tasks.
speech: Improve inference latency and reduce computational requirements to enable real-time speech recognition on resource-constrained devices.
storage: Improve read latency and throughput under high concurrency by reducing lock contention in memtable and cache access paths.
systems: Improve comprehensive performance benchmarking and optimization guidance for production deployments across various hardware configurations and workload patterns.
thin-gnn: Improve distributed training scalability and performance across multiple devices/clusters for large-scale GNN model deployment.
thin-kv: Improve query performance and latency to compete with established distributed databases under high-throughput production workloads.
thin-lang: Improve language feature completeness, standard library coverage, and compiler optimization to reach production-ready status.
vectordb: Improve distributed multi-node scalability and cross-shard query performance to handle massive-scale deployments more efficiently.
webdev: Flask needs better built-in support for asynchronous request handling and async/await patterns in modern Python web applications.
